meaning_en: to flow in copious continuous stream under head pressure

past.ar: سَحَّ المَاءُ النَّقِيُّ مِنْ فُوَّهَةِ الصُّعُودِ
past.de: Das reine Wasser strömte aus der Auslauföffnung hervor
past.en: The pure water flowed copiously from the rising outlet

present.ar: يَسُحُّ الجَدْوَلُ بِلَا انْقِطَاعٍ نَحْوَ الحُقُولِ
present.de: Der Strom fließt ununterbrochen zu den Äckern
present.en: The stream flows unceasingly toward the tilled fields

imperative.de: Fließe reichlich, um Saat und Baum zu tränken!
imperative.en: Flow copiously to nourish crops and trees!
